summary: Gone FFLOS tower site in Mercer County, registered in 2017. The registers give its position and number, but no history or site description.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. No source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

events.note: Date registered per the FFLOS detail page: January 26, 2017

evidence.supports: Mercer County; near 37.39 N, 81.30 W; tower, gone
evidence.quote: Mercer McComas 37.39041 -81.29892 Tower Gone FFLOS US 1638, WV 29
The first fire towers were erected in 1916.

evidence.supports: state forest fire towers closed in 1990
evidence.quote: forest fire towers were closed in 1990

evidence.supports: readings from two or more towers locate the fire
evidence.quote: By comparing the readings from two or more towers one could pinpoint the location of the fire
This method is known as triangulation.

notes_for_editor: No source found gives a builder, owner, staffing, build year, or removal date for the McComas tower; two web searches and the register pages were checked. The two registers give coordinates a few tens of metres apart (FFLOS 37.390278, -81.299167; FFLA 37.39041, -81.29892); the record keeps the FFLOS point. The e-WV entry says both 'Less than a dozen remain standing today' and 'dozens of fire towers are still standing', which contradict each other, so the story avoids any count. The 1990 closure date comes from e-WV alone and may not apply to every tower.
